learning_objectives: By the end of this tutorial, you will be able to explain what Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is and how it works.
outline: Introduction to the 'closed-book' problem in AI
The 3-step RAG flow: Query, Retrieve, Generate
Benefits of using RAG for AI applications
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and their working.

slides.title: Welcome to the Tutorial
slides.narration:
Hello and welcome to this **Spoken Tutorial** on **Retrieval-Augmented Generation**, or **RAG**.
Here, we will learn how **RAG** helps **AI** models give better answers.

slides.title: Learning Objective
slides.narration:
By the end of this tutorial, you will learn what **Retrieval-Augmented Generation**, or **RAG**, is.
You will also understand how **RAG** works.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you need a computer and good internet.
You do not need to install any special software for this lesson.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
Before you start, you should know what **Large Language Models**, or **LLMs**, are.
You should also know how they write text.
This will help you understand **RAG** better.

slides.title: The 'Closed-Book' Problem
slides.narration:
Have you seen an **AI** give wrong answers, especially for new information?
This happens because the **AI** answers only from what it already knows.
It is like a student taking a 'closed-book' exam.
slides.image_prompt: An AI chatbot looking confused, with a thought bubble showing vague or incorrect information.

slides.title: Introducing RAG: The Solution
slides.narration:
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation**, or **RAG**, solves this 'closed-book' problem.
It is a simple idea that helps **AI** models give much better answers.
Think of it like an 'open-book' exam.
slides.image_prompt: A student happily taking an exam with an open book next to them, contrasting with another student struggling with a closed book.

slides.title: How RAG Works
slides.narration:
**RAG** connects outside knowledge with the **AI** model.
It gives the **AI** new facts to read before it answers your question.
This helps the **AI** give correct and full answers.
slides.image_prompt: A large language model brain icon with arrows pointing to external knowledge sources like books and documents, showing integration.

slides.title: The 'Retrieval' (R) Component
slides.narration:
The 'Retrieval' part of **RAG** is like a smart Librarian.
When you ask a question, it searches a special knowledge base.
This knowledge base can be your **PDF** files, company documents, or other papers.
slides.image_prompt: A friendly librarian character searching through a digital library database, with various documents and PDFs floating around.

slides.title: The Librarian's Job
slides.narration:
The Librarian finds the exact parts of documents that match your question.
It quickly gets the best information for the **AI**.
This is the first important step in **RAG**.
slides.image_prompt: A digital hand pointing to highlighted relevant paragraphs within a stack of documents, indicating precise retrieval.

slides.title: The 'Generation' (G) Component
slides.narration:
The 'Generation' part is the **AI** model itself, like an Expert.
It gets two things: your question and the useful documents from the Librarian.
slides.image_prompt: An AI chatbot character (Eloquent Expert) receiving two inputs: a speech bubble with a question and a stack of documents.

slides.title: The Expert's New Job
slides.narration:
Now, the Expert does not answer from its own memory.
It is told to answer your question by using only the documents given to it.
This makes sure the answer is based on facts.
slides.image_prompt: The AI chatbot character confidently answering a question while pointing to the provided documents as its source, not its head.

slides.title: The 3-Step RAG Flow
slides.narration:
**RAG** works in 3 simple steps.
Step 1: You ask a question.
Step 2: The system finds information.
Step 3: The system gives you an answer.
Many 'Chat with your data' apps use this method.
slides.image_prompt: A clear flowchart showing three connected boxes: 'Query' -> 'Retrieve' -> 'Generate', with an arrow looping back from 'Generate' to 'Query'.

slides.title: Benefits of RAG
slides.narration:
**RAG** makes the **AI** give true and clear answers.
The **AI** can now show its sources.
This helps you trust the **AI**'s answers more.
It gives better and more useful information.
slides.image_prompt: An AI chatbot providing an answer with a small citation icon or footnote, next to a checkmark indicating accuracy.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, we learned about **Retrieval-Augmented Generation**, or **RAG**.
**RAG** helps **AI** models give better answers.
It does this by finding outside information and then creating a response.
This makes answers more correct and easy to check.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
For your assignment, find an example of a 'Chat with your data' app that uses **RAG**.
Try to see how the finding and creating parts work in that app.
